segments.expected: Kiva felt them as she came out of the side door onto the floor. It was not like Friday. On Friday the whole town had stood up for Carrow, and Kiva had been one of eight people on a floor. Today it did not stand. It sat, tier after tier, in green and in grey and in the colours of six circuits, and every face in the lower tiers turned as she came out of the door and followed her across the stone to Seven's hurdle, and she felt it on the side of her face and the back of her neck like the sun.
